oneResponsibility.notes: Exact-inventory review of all 2944 staged production C# files by the AI reviewer under the author's explicit Addendum 9 ruling of 2026-09-02. Method: ten read-only reviewer passes over per-directory manifests (Growth x3, Core x2, Experience x2, Simulation, Polity+Chronicle+Founding+Treaty, Trade+Api+Quests+World+Debug+Raids+Integrations); every file's declarations were enumerated and 1,148 files (39%) were read whole by risk. Fourteen Required ownership faults were found and every one fixed before signing, each a verbatim relocation into a single-purpose shard with source-contract pins retargeted: the KingdomDesignationIndex anchor out of KingdomDesignationRules; the KingdomCommunalRiteRules recovery transition out of the Models file; the KingdomSuccession reign bridge out of Core body-history; KingdomMarketStockProtection and the r_KingdomLegendaryMarketProjection anchor into their own files; KingdomSystem exile regard/return callbacks out of the persistence-hook shard (z18a); the polity realm-transition CAS ladder consolidated into KingdomPolityRules.RealmTransition(+Validation), scheduler prose into pure KingdomPolityArrivalPresentationRules, the endpoint root collector into Locator.Roots; carry haul, notable-guest, carry-sign and guest IParts into standalone files; guest-feast opportunity/locus and lifecycle option/carry-sink rules into their own shards; KingdomInheritanceLifecycle split from its load-source classifier and lease owner; KingdomInheritanceState z10 split into reservation leases and discoverability; KingdomBounty publication split into publication/sinks/cleanup/schedule. 0 Required remain; Questions and Nits are recorded, not silently accepted. Re-bound after the live matrix closed three founding regressions (basin anchor role, zone-free stamped-rect reader, founder-first species) and added the 07n refusal-diagnostics shard; each single-purpose, self-reviewed.

protocolsAtBoundaries.notes: Boundary review of every seam kind on the same inventory: engine (XRL GameObject/Zone/Cell/parts/events), serialization (SerializationWriter/Reader, BinaryWriter codecs, TAP2 polity envelope v1-v9, lifecycle TLC2/TCC2/TGR1, realm archive v1-v8, archived-settlement v1-v18, treaty, chronicle registry, city book), public Api (ThousandAndFirst.Api contracts, r_* IParts, XML data), and third-party (Hearthpyre 2.2.3 bridge). Every catch site in Polity/, Core/, Experience/ and the periphery was swept: none hides a state mutation whose failure is not otherwise surfaced. Four Required protocol faults were found and fixed: the city book now refuses (never reinterprets) persisted enum/narrow columns outside their domain, pinned by 43 new refusal and boundary cases; the mirror-gate arch register now carries a version token, reads legacy text as v1, refuses a newer build's register without repair or rewrite, and keeps drop-and-count repair only for known versions, pinned by tests; the designation and foreign-footprint provider contracts now cross only Api types (KingdomApiCell, KingdomApiDesignation) with host-side translation that bounds-checks every cell and grants external rows open-yard use only, pinned by tests and documented in docs/API.md; and a latent Enum.IsDefined int-versus-byte throw in the job registry's resident-transition projection was replaced by a byte-range check. Positive evidence retained per slice: versioned, bounded, future-opaque wire readers with quarantine-then-rethrow; revision-CAS commits that re-validate the candidate; engine objects re-proved by global id and ownership stamps on every use; IParts that block engine removal without an armed token and inert their clones. Remaining Questions (e.g. the EndpointVerb string multiplex, the un-receipted Chronicle.Record lane, provider contract versioning) are recorded in the ledger as follow-ups, not exceptions.
